body:
Scope: renewed fresh final whole-change Code Review after completed M1 and its required public-skill portability correction. Complete delivered engineering range: 873f0a238ac5d6d240d5920946a882b54f0e4175 to baa1da618337c9606fc24231d56ecaece529554f; all exact current engineering subjects are recorded below. No implementation milestone remains open. M2 is lifecycle closeout. This review renews my final engineering judgment; it does not renew Verify or another actor's evidence.

Fresh integrated assessment traced current approved proposal, both Design members, revised Delivery allocation and all consumer/generation changes. Reviewed current complete engineering scope, current full subject content, actual committed diff, correction diff and cross-consumer dependencies. The portability correction removes private requirement IDs and internal Design-checkout commentary from published introductions. Customer project policy remains the express authority, explicit adoption remains required, historical contracts retain meaning, and specialized reviewer methods still apply the same shared assessment/reliance rules. Internal clause mapping remains in governing Design rather than the shipped customer flow. Resource selection is still four assessment consumers plus ten reliance consumers; all local copies and generated packages have current matching proof. No public interface, schema, stage or runtime readiness decision was introduced.

Whole-change composition: proposal/design/delivery judgments retain bounded consequence; the plan explicitly allocates final whole-change review after every implementation/correction; Delivery Review checks omission; milestone and final Code Review remain distinct; route cannot restore the reviewer's applicability; Verify separately evaluates evidence/coherence and owns its blocker dispositions and success-only explanation; PR/CI/implementation preserve separate correction and external-action authority. Historical recording vocabulary/proof formats remain explicitly scoped, while customer-installed resources are sufficient without internal repository IDs or checkout references. The bounded JSON validation correction selects existing complete-set validation for malformed/unknown roots and selected snapshots while preserving historical YAML behavior; generated candidate metadata changes reflect only current package bytes.

TG-FINAL-1 reviewed anew against composed guidance: required owner decision plus concrete defect remains blocked with the defect retained; materially missing basis plus bounded defect remains inconclusive with that finding; optional notes alone do not defeat approval; author role reset is not independence; bookkeeping plus new failed evidence triggers semantic assessment; changed engineering after final review requires owned correction and adequate reassessment; Code Review cannot dispose Verify's blocker. Concurrent basis changes stop reliance, interrupted recording requires owned recovery, changed proof environments defeat reuse where material, and a single/doc-only milestone still requires final whole-change review independently of integrated test-group applicability. Advisory assessment stays bounded. These are manual source-guidance assessments with explicit limits, not executable policy-judge or token-saving claims.

All ten checklist dimensions pass on this final engineering basis: approved requirement alignment and non-goals; direct regression/manual coverage; composed edge cases; fail-closed error handling; policy/coordination/storage architecture; historical and customer compatibility; privacy/authority boundaries including the user's correction; current generated resources; unrelated-scope exclusion; sufficient applicable proof for Code Review. No new material finding or unresolved necessary decision emerged. Prior Design findings retain explicit resolved dispositions and immutable origin identities.

Fresh affected proof is public-skill-portability-correction: validate-skills (20), build-skills --check, test-skill-validator (370), current adapter metadata regression, all three adapter builds/parity and published Markdown scan, npm test (654 total, 652 pass, 2 skip), and diff whitespace check. The earlier complete PR-mode 18-check pass supports unchanged lifecycle/selector/model/structural code and historical fixtures because those implementations, tests, governing inputs, dependencies and environment are unchanged. The final correction changes only introductory wording and derived metadata/test expectations; fresh proof covers those changed surfaces, and the unchanged substantive guidance retains prior scenario proof with renewed integrated assessment here. This does not imply the earlier integrated command ran on corrected bytes or waive any explicitly fresh/current-state check. Current record metadata and exact committed record-set checks were separately supplied as passed; Verify must consume current records and owning proof before renewing completion.

Engineering subjects are current and exact. Stage-owned recording/evidence changes are assessed by content/effect rather than blanket byte invalidation; contradictory new proof or new engineering changes still require assessment before reliance. Unrelated docs/design.zip remains outside the reviewed contribution. This final judgment supports Verify's separate renewed assessment and does not claim its success, a correction-head hosted CI pass, or permission to perform external actions.
independence_basis: Separate nonauthor agent /root/independent_proposal_review freshly assessed the complete final engineering change after M1 and its public-skill correction were completed. Root authored all engineering corrections; this reviewer authored assessment records only. Earlier milestone and final reviews informed comparison but were not substituted for this renewed integrated assessment.
